The project's own work, © 2026 Alexandre Enouf:

## Not covered: Mega Crit content

*Slay the Spire* and *Slay the Spire 2*, their names, logos, characters, card, relic, potion, event and monster
names and texts, numbers and game design, and **all their artwork** are the property of Mega Crit. They are
reproduced here for a fan adaptation and are **not** licensed under MIT, nor under any license from this project.
This covers in particular:

* the illustrations in `bible/images/`, and everything generated from them in `graphics/`, `site/` and the ROMs;
* the reference data and texts in `bible/` (`bible/data/*.json`, the design documents), and the names and texts
  of the game content in the code (`src/engine/card_db.cpp`, `src/engine/events/`, `src/gba/card_text.cpp`…).

Anyone reusing this project must remove or replace this content, or obtain Mega Crit's permission. Rights holders
can ask for any of it to be changed or removed by opening an issue or writing to
[alexandre.enouf@gmail.com](mailto:alexandre.enouf@gmail.com).

included.
